channel.title: SolarWinds — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by SolarWinds (solarwinds).

item.title: CVE-2026-123173 · 6.8 MEDIUM 🌩️ — SolarWinds Serv-U Length Confusion Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by an out-of-bounds memory read that could allow an attacker to disclose data from server memory.

item.title: CVE-2026-123172 · 9.1 CRITICAL — SolarWinds Serv-U Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
item.description: Solarwinds Serv-U is affected by a privilege escalation vulnerability that, when exploited, could lead to the escalation of privileges to root for Linux installations. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-123171 · 5.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — SolarWinds Serv-U Username Enumeration Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be affected by a username enumeration vulnerability allowing an attacker to determine whether specific user accounts exist.

item.title: CVE-2026-123170 · 6.5 MEDIUM 🌩️ — SolarWinds Serv-U First-Factor Password Brute Force Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be affected by a vulnerability allowing an attacker to repeatedly attempt authentication due to insufficient protection against password brute-force attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-123169 · 5.4 MEDIUM — SolarWinds Serv-U TOTP Brute Force and Code Replay Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be affected by an authentication vulnerability in its TOTP-based multi-factor authentication mechanism due to insufficient brute-force protection.

item.title: CVE-2026-123168 · 9.1 CRITICAL — SolarWinds Serv-U Insufficient Validation Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by an insufficient validation vulnerability that, when exploited, could lead to privilege escalation into the root user in Linux installations. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-123167 · 9.1 CRITICAL — Solarwinds Serv-U Privilege Escalation via Path Traversal Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by a privilege escalation vulnerability that, when exploited, can allow a domain administrator to access files that otherwise would require elevated privileges. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-123166 · 7.2 HIGH — SolarWinds Serv-U Command Injection Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U fails to properly sanitize user-controlled arguments, which could allow the injection of commands. This only affects Windows installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-123165 · 4.7 MEDIUM 🌩️ — SolarWinds Serv-U HTTP Response Header Injection Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be vulnerable to an unauthenticated HTTP response header injection vulnerability that allows an attacker to manipulate a victim's browser session.

item.title: CVE-2026-82322 · 9.1 CRITICAL — SolarWinds Serv-U Privilege Escalation via IDOR Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability that allows a domain group administrator to bypass restrictions and escalate privileges to the server administrator level. The risk is lower for Windows install…

item.title: CVE-2026-82321 · 9.1 CRITICAL — SolarWinds Serv-U Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be affected by a type confusion vulnerability that may allow domain administrators to escalate privileges to that of a system administrator. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-82320 · 9.1 CRITICAL — SolarWinds Serv-U Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U was found to be affected by another type confusion vulnerability that may allow domain administrators to escalate privileges to that of a system administrator. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

item.title: CVE-2026-82317 · 6.8 MEDIUM — SolarWinds Serv-U Stored Cross-Site Scripting Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability. This is a Linux-only issue that was caused by a lack of input validation and only affects administrators.

item.title: CVE-2026-28336 · 9.9 CRITICAL — SolarWinds Dameware Command Injection Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Dameware was found to be affected by a command injection vulnerability that could lead to the compromise of the remotely controlled host. Authentication is required.

item.title: CVE-2026-28335 · 8.4 HIGH — SolarWinds Dameware Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Dameware was found to be affected by a buffer overflow vulnerability that can result in remote code execution. Authentication is required.

item.title: CVE-2026-28327 · 8.2 HIGH — SolarWinds Dameware DLL Hijacking Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Dameware was found to be affected by a DLL hijacking vulnerability. The hijack occurs during installations only and requires access to the local machine and admin privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-28329 · 6.4 MEDIUM — SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)
item.description: SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted was found to be affected by a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that allows authenticated attackers to cause the application server to send requests to attacker-controlled or internal destinations.

item.title: CVE-2026-28328 · 8.8 HIGH — SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted broken authorization schema
item.description: SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted was found to be affected by a broken authorization schema that can allow low-privileged users to access and modify information beyond their assigned permissions.

item.title: CVE-2026-28331 · 4.4 MEDIUM — SolarWinds Patch Manager Sensitive Information Exposure Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Patch Manager exposes sensitive information accessible to local users, which could be used to gain elevated privileges.

item.title: CVE-2026-28325 · 8.8 HIGH — SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted was found to be affected by an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability stemming from deserialization of untrusted data when the application is configured to use a specific communication mode.

item.title: CVE-2026-28324 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Observability Self-Hosted was found to be affected by an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability due to the insufficient integrity checks. Installations configured in a non-default and non-secure configuration are affected.

item.title: CVE-2026-28326 · 8.8 HIGH — SolarWinds Access Rights Manager Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
item.description: SolarWinds Access Rights Manager was reported to be affected by an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability. The issue stems from a hardcoded static key.

item.description: SolarWinds Web Help Desk is found to be affected by a SAML authentication bypass vulnerability. This requires the SAML 2.0 authentication method to be enabled.
